properties.name: sbom:scope
properties.value: Source repository inventory only; completeness is UNKNOWN. Syft inventories tracked source/package manifests. Gitlinks and declared vendored/model evidence are inspected at immutable pins. CMake declarations are conditional requirements, not resolved installations. This is NOT proof of operating-system packages, static-link closure, build-time resolution, or the contents of release binaries.
